observed: Owner console saved exact Customer, Note and Opportunity bindings for loopback website only. No public domain bindings were changed.
recommendation: Keep IDs, route, visible control label and effect family reviewed for each host.

feature: Reusable saved workflow group
observed: The same saved local workflow group was reused across runs 4064, 4065 and 4066. The published manual-only 10-node definition retained its group ID while replacement panels explicitly linked to it.
recommendation: Future user panels must explicitly link to this existing group; offline panels receive no commands.

feature: Workflow Customer → Note → Opportunity saved end to end
observed: Run 4066 completed all 10 nodes. The workflow alone filled and saved Customer, Note and Opportunity. Three HTTP 200 host POSTs matched three exact records independently read from the host records page. No observer host fill, Save click or direct record write.
recommendation: Retain the full UI journey and exact independent readback. This proves these three synthetic records, not arbitrary business-system success.

feature: Live Save execution after classification correction
observed: All three native Save nodes executed through exact owner-reviewed local bindings under the internal-write policy. The preceding fill steps used the explicitly approved, workflow-specific three-use temporary grant. No visitor review-button click was performed.
recommendation: Keep visitor review and autonomous workflow authority distinct. A binding is not a general permission to save; each effect still requires policy authorization.

feature: Temporary UAT grant cleanup
observed: Run 4066 consumed all three approved fill uses. The exact temporary workflow override was removed afterward. Independent readback confirms zero overrides for this workflow; company internal writes remain autonomous, external messages require approval, and destructive actions remain prohibited.
recommendation: Future runs must satisfy current policy again; this UAT grant is no longer available.

feature: Broad generic intelligent UI-agent coverage
observed: Seven representative live intent cases, ten DOM/framework checks and one three-form saved workflow pass. These do not establish unrestricted browser-agent parity across arbitrary websites. Selective maker/checker remains a proposal and is not implemented.
recommendation: Benchmark diverse controls, ambiguous requests, recovery and latency before expanding autonomy. If added, use a separate configured checker selectively; deterministic authorization and host readback remain authoritative.
